invariants.request: request_id!=0, command is a Phase 0.5 command, error_code=Success
invariants.response: request_id!=0, command echoes its request, error_code is canonical
invariants.success_response: error_code=Success and payload is the command result
invariants.error_response: error_code!=Success and payload is bounded opaque diagnostic control data
invariants.unknown_values: unknown kind, command, error code, flags, or reserved values are malformed

payload_semantics.encoding: opaque command-owned control bytes; a later command contract may require UTF-8 JSON
payload_semantics.get_capabilities: empty request; bounded response control data
payload_semantics.run_mock_pipeline: bounded parameters/result summary only; PCM, model bytes, and audio buffers are forbidden
payload_semantics.error: at most 4096 diagnostic bytes; never PCM, model bytes, or audio buffers

decoder.failed_state: after a fatal error, feed/eof repeat the original fatal framing error until explicit reset
decoder.feed_atomicity: a feed call containing a fatal frame returns no messages from that call
decoder.retention: retain at most one legal frame and reject oversized payload_length before body allocation
decoder.eof: empty boundary is clean; a partial header or body is MalformedFrame

transport.stdout: C++ stdout is reserved exclusively for framed protocol bytes
transport.diagnostics: diagnostics and logs use stderr or files
